item.title: Kate Hudson welcomes Super Bowl back to Los Angeles
item.description: Hudson appears in a new video ahead of the 2027 Super Bowl at SoFi Stadium, with a ticket giveaway for one fan.

item.title: Hackers raise refrigerator temperatures at hundreds of supermarkets
item.description: The cyberattack caused refrigerators to heat up in hundreds of stores, sparking fires and forcing spoiled food to be discarded.

item.title: Hurricane Simon hits Mexico's Pacific coast, affecting resorts and towns
item.description: Though Simon weakened on Monday, the hurricane continued to batter vulnerable areas along Mexico's Pacific Coast.

item.title: Judge criticizes DOJ after 430 trees cut at D.C. golf course
item.description: Government lawyers said 430 trees were cut down at East Potomac Golf Links on Saturday.
